description: Keyword research: up to 50 keyword ideas for a seed keyword with monthly searches, difficulty, cost per click and intent. Use to find what people search for around a topic before writing a page or picking keywords to track. One country per call. Returns seed, count and keywords[] {keyword, volume, difficulty 0-100, cpc, intent}. Not charged when the data source fails. Price: $0.05 per call from Exepal credit; not charged if the call fails.

seed.description: A keyword or topic, e.g. crm for startups

name: seo_keywords

position.description: Google position, null when not known or not ranking

traffic.description: Estimated monthly visits from this keyword

match.description: close: ideas contain or sit next to the seed; loose: only nearby searches sharing its main words; none: nothing on topic

note.description: Plain-language note when ideas are thin or loose

seedVolume.description: Monthly searches for the seed itself; null when Google has no data

title: Keyword ideas
